sentence: This project studies how genetic changes in certain immune-related receptors cause disease, using structural biology techniques to define their biochemical basis in autoimmunity.
This project offers drug discovery services such as computational modeling, high throughput screening, peptide synthesis and protein structure work to help develop therapeutics.
This project tries to find out whether prostate cancer starts in inflamed regions of the prostate and learns to evade the immune system there.
This project runs a lab-based short course that teaches methods used in cancer neuroscience.
This project studies how insufficient sleep and circadian dysregulation contribute to health problems such as cardiovascular disease, obesity and diabetes.
This project tries to find out how nitration of a molecular adaptor protein contributes to hearing damage caused by the cancer drug cisplatin.
This project develops a fluid mechanics method to measure how tracers move through tissue in magnetic resonance imaging.
This project uses small RNAseq and machine learning to find isomiRs in blood that tell apart different causes of ischemic stroke.
This project tests whether brain stimulation called theta burst can change activity in the hippocampus of people with schizophrenia.
This project builds bioinformatics methods that combine large genetic datasets from human hosts and pathogens to find pathways and protein networks to test.
This project tests how measures of brain activity in young autistic children relate to social attention and social interaction with caregivers.
This project builds a magnetic nanoparticle agent that shows brain tumors on magnetic particle imaging and destroys them with heat.
This project uses mutant mouse models to test whether treatments given in utero can prevent cleft lip and palate during fetal development.
This project builds methods to study how proteins from endogenous retroviruses evolved to do jobs in cells, tissues and animals.
This project supports clinical research and helps bring scientific discoveries into patient care.
This project studies the structure and activity of mammalian DNA polymerase theta, an enzyme that repairs genomic damage.
This project builds an x-ray cabinet system that delivers both ultra-high and conventional dose-rate irradiation for pre-clinical laboratory research.
This project studies how the fungus Candida glabrata and bacteria differ in metabolic activity in people with C. difficile infection.
This project applies data fusion methods to large trials to estimate relapse risk under different treatment strategies for opioid use disorder.
This project studies risk factors and patient preferences related to high blood pressure after pregnancy to map how to detect and reduce it.
